notes: Key finding: all 5 convertible regression-sample documents resolve to code paths (primary pymupdf4llm tier, or derive_toc_markdown for the one TOC-present doc) that never call the modified is_heading_candidate()/derive_heuristic_markdown() functions under real auto-mode operation -- confirmed via [convert] Engine used: log lines on every run, not assumed. This makes the no-regression finding structural, not merely empirical. Forced-fallback testing (LITERATURE_CONVERTER=fallback) against a reconstructed pre-Phase-7 copy of literature-convert.sh (saved at scratchpad literature-convert-OLD.sh, spliced from the exact pre-edit function bodies) directly confirmed byte-identical output for proofs_and_types (TOC path, untouched) and confirmed the OCR-producer detector and raised corroboration bar fire correctly on Wijesekera's real PDF metadata.
